# KZM

> Free mod launcher for Katana ZERO on Windows. Install .kzm packages, keep mod profiles, and launch the game from one app.

KZM (Katana ZERO Modding) is an independent community project. It is not affiliated with Askiisoft. A legally owned copy of Katana ZERO is required.

## Pages

- [Русский](https://kzm.bar/): бесплатный лаунчер модов для Katana ZERO
- [English](https://kzm.bar/en/): free Katana ZERO mod launcher
